name: Fuchsgrub
beschreibung: The holiday home Fuchsgrub is located on the outskirts of Ebbs, a village in the Austrian Unterland. The surroundings are rural, with meadows and a view of the surrounding hills of the Kaisergebirge. Guests can expect simple, well-maintained holiday apartments with a kitchen and balcony. The property offers access to the garden. Parking spaces are available.
